title: Domain Registrations Multi-Year Term Credit Schedule for Manual Renewal Price Matches
content:
Schedule of the manual line's term credit, one of the charge's Domain Care credits of a manual renewal charge on a Domain Registrations domain. It depends only on the years that manual renewal charge covered.

**Rule.** The manual line's term credit is USD 0.60 times the years the charge covered where they come to 5 or more, the flat USD 1.00 where they come to 2 to 4, and nothing where they come to 1.

| Years the manual renewal charge covered | Term credit |
|---|---|
| 1 | nothing |
| 2 | USD 1.00 |
| 3 | USD 1.00 |
| 4 | USD 1.00 |
| 5 | USD 3.00 (5 times USD 0.60) |
| 6 | USD 3.60 |
| 7 | USD 4.20 |
| 8 | USD 4.80 |
| 9 | USD 5.40 |
| 10 | USD 6.00 |

**Boundaries.** At 4 years the flat USD 1.00 still applies; at 5 years the charge moves to USD 0.60 for every year it covered, not only the years beyond 4. A charge that covered a single year earns no term credit.

**Which years.** The years are those recorded on the manual renewal charge line itself.
